title: Fix sliding-window rate limiter boundary and per-key isolation
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `ratelimit/limiter.py`:
1. `SlidingWindowLimiter(max_requests, window_seconds, clock=time.monotonic)` must track timestamps per `key` independently (currently a single global list is shared).
2. Requests at `t - window_seconds` or earlier (`ts <= now - window_seconds`) are expired and must not count toward `max_requests`.
3. Rejected requests (`allow(key) -> False`) must NOT record a timestamp in the window.
Run `pytest` and verify edge cases.
